svg.title: The Judgment Seat of Christ
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 6 panels. Panel 1 (Isaiah 61:10): Jesus holding out a white robe to a kneeling man in soiled clothes. Caption: "Before any work is weighed, the robe is given." Isaiah says: "He has clothed me with the garments of salvation; he has covered me with the robe of righteousness." Note: "Isaiah’s picture. Washed white in the Lamb’s blood (Revelation 7:14)." Panel 2 (2 Corinthians 5:10): Jesus standing on a raised stone tribunal, three believers in white robes standing before Him. Caption: "At His coming: the βῆμα, the judgment seat." Paul says: "For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ." Panel 3 (1 Corinthians 3:13-14): a building of gold, silver and precious stones standing whole in the fire on its stone foundation, its builder in a white robe holding up a gold wreath. Caption: "The fire tests each one’s work." Paul says: "If the work that anyone has built on the foundation survives, he will receive a reward." Panel 4 (1 Corinthians 3:15): a building of wood and straw burning on its stone foundation, its builder still in a white robe walking out of it with empty hands. Caption: "Another builder’s work burns." Paul says: "He will suffer loss, though he himself will be saved, but only as through fire." Note: "The work burns. The robe does not (Romans 8:1)." Panel 5 (Revelation 4:10-11): four elders in white robes kneeling before a throne of light, holding out gold wreaths, with three wreaths already laid before the throne. Caption: "Every crown goes back to the throne." Every elder says: "Worthy are you, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power." Note: "Drawn: four of the twenty-four elders. Revelation does not say who they are." Then a break in time: A thousand years (Revelation 20:5, 7). Panel 6 (Revelation 20:11-15): the dead, great and small, standing before a great white throne of light, with books lying open before it. Caption: "Then a different judgment: the great white throne." John says: "I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened." John says: "If anyone’s name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire." Note: "Here the question is whose name is in the book of life." The point: You stand before Christ’s judgment seat in a robe washed in His blood; there your work is tested for reward or loss, and every crown goes back to Him. Both the robe and the reward are His gift (2 Corinthians 5:10; Revelation 4:10).
svg.text: The robe first, then the fire

g.text: Drawn: four of the twenty-four elders.
Revelation does not say who they are.
name is in the book of life.
